decisions.statement: The page types a plural gathers pages of are handed in rather than worked out here.
A page type that plural covers is one of those page types or a page type extending one.
A name names a page type covered whose own plural is that name.
A name names a page type covered whose slug is that name.
A name names a page type covered whose slug ends with `-` and that name.
Every page type a name names is answered rather than the first one found.
Nothing here reads the folder the name was taken from.

definition: how a folder's name is read as naming the page types one plural covers
